title: autospec-fab release-gate
description: Aggregated release-gate report for the autospec-fab pipeline (.autospec/fab/release-gate.json). Stages are written by individual stage scripts and aggregated by the engine.

schema_version.description: Schema version; always 1 for this revision.

name.description: Optional model name this gate report is for (set by the engine, #1234).

geometry_hash.description: Optional geometry hash of the model (engine #1234) feeding the FEA/CFD freshness cache.

stages.description: Ordered list of stage records, one per fab pipeline stage.

detail.description: Human-readable summary of the stage outcome.

findings.description: Structured findings emitted by the stage (code_health ids etc.).

freshness.description: Geometry-hash cache state used to decide whether FEA/CFD results are still fresh.

fea_results.description: CalculiX FEA results summary for load-critical parts.

cfd_results.description: OpenFOAM CFD results summary for flow-critical parts.

vision_findings.description: Advisory observations from the vision stage (never blocking).
